# JRDB-Social

Robot-view observations and contextual social-group annotations in human environments.

## Example input and output

Author-published figure. This is a depicted example, not a transcribed annotation row.

**Input:** Robot-view cafeteria image in Figure 1, with two people seated at a table near a pillar.

**Output / label:** The group-level description assigns the aim 'working and socializing'. This is an annotator-written group purpose, alongside individual and pairwise annotations.

![Official JRDB-Social teaser showing people and social-group annotations](https://jrdb.erc.monash.edu/static/images/social/teaser.png)

## Intention in this dataset

Social grouping and interaction context can inform reasoning about human social purpose; group activity annotations are not direct intention reports.

**Relevance:** `related` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2024

**Domains:** social_interaction, human_robot_interaction  
**Intention types:** social  
**Tasks:**   
**Modalities:** rgb, lidar, trajectory  
**Formats:** video, time_series, structured_annotation

## Limits and notes

Social context is included as an intention cue; action and group labels are not relabeled as intentions.
